<description>
Calling `BroadcastTransaction` with the `NO_MEMPOOL_PRIVATE_BROADCAST` method skips inserting the transaction into the mempool and returns immediately. This causes problems with software that expects the transaction to be in the mempool after the function returns. For example many third-party wallets or services call `sendrawtransaction` and expect the transaction to be in the mempool after it returns a successful response.

This PR adds a new `TransactionAddedToMempoolSync` method to `CValidationInterface`. This is then used in `BroadcastTransaction` when the method is `NO_MEMPOOL_PRIVATE_BROADCAST` to wait for the transaction to have been accepted back into the mempool before returning. It also adds a timeout (default 10 minutes) to `BroadcastTransaction` and exposes it as an option for `sendrawtransaction`. Setting the timeout to 0 disables the wait and returns immediately, preserving the current behavior.

Synchronously waiting for mempool acceptance is also a prerequisite for adding private broadcast support to the wallet. The `TransactionAddedToMempoolSync` method is added specifically for future wallet broadcasting, so a broadcast caller holding `cs_wallet` will not timeout waiting on another background event that is also trying to acquire `cs_wallet`.
</description>

<commits>
9e7e5dcf78 validation: add synchronous mempool acceptance notification

Notify validation subscribers synchronously after queuing the existing mempool acceptance event. This allows acceptance waiters to wake independently of the background notification queue.

8f89a7a95a node: support waiting for private broadcast mempool acceptance

Subscribe before private broadcast submission and wait for local mempool acceptance, timeout, or shutdown. Synchronous acceptance notifications allow callers holding the wallet lock to wait without draining its notification queue.

9f3c95e8c4 rpc: wait for private broadcast acceptance in sendrawtransaction

Expose the private broadcast timeout in sendrawtransaction and default private broadcasts to a ten-minute wait.

bccae01515 doc: add release notes for private broadcast wait
</commits>

+Updated RPCs
+------------
+
+With `-privatebroadcast`, `sendrawtransaction` now waits for local mempool
+acceptance. The new optional `timeout` argument defaults to 10 minutes.
+
+A timeout will return an error, but the broadcast will not be cancelled.
+Use `getprivatebroadcastinfo` to inspect the status of the broadcast.
+
+Set `timeout` to `0` to return immediately without waiting for mempool acceptance.

+#!/usr/bin/env python3
+# Copyright (c) The Bitcoin Core developers
+# Distributed under the MIT software license, see the accompanying
+# file COPYING or https://opensource.org/license/mit/.
+"""Test private-broadcast RPC acceptance waits, timeouts, and shutdown."""
+
+from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor
+from contextlib import ExitStack
+
+from test_framework.messages import malleate_tx_to_invalid_witness, msg_tx
+from test_framework.p2p import P2PInterface
+from test_framework.test_framework import BitcoinTestFramework
+from test_framework.util import assert_equal, assert_raises_rpc_error
+from test_framework.wallet import MiniWallet
+
+
+class PrivateBroadcastWaitTest(BitcoinTestFramework):
+    def set_test_params(self):
+        self.num_nodes = 1
+        self.disable_autoconnect = False
+        # We don't use the proxy in this test. This is just a dummy so the node will start with privatebroadcast.
+        self.extra_args = [["-privatebroadcast", "-proxy=127.0.0.1:1"]]
+
+    def run_test(self):
+        node = self.nodes[0]
+        peer = node.add_p2p_connection(P2PInterface())
+        wallet = MiniWallet(node)
+        rpc = node.create_new_rpc_connection()
+
+        with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=1) as executor, ExitStack() as cleanup:
+            cleanup.callback(node.stop_node)
+
+            self.log.info("Timeout leaves the broadcast queued")
+            tx = wallet.create_self_transfer()
+            assert_raises_rpc_error(-25, "Timed out waiting for mempool acceptance", node.sendrawtransaction, tx["hex"], timeout=100)
+            assert_equal([t["wtxid"] for t in node.getprivatebroadcastinfo()["transactions"]], [tx["wtxid"]])
+
+            def submit(tx):
+                # Wait for this RPC, even when a previous attempt is already queued.
+                with node.assert_debug_log([f"txid={tx['txid']}, wtxid={tx['wtxid']}"], timeout=10):
+                    future = executor.submit(rpc.sendrawtransaction, tx["hex"])
+                return future
+
+            self.log.info("Retrying with the default timeout waits for mempool acceptance")
+            result = submit(tx)
+            peer.send_and_ping(msg_tx(malleate_tx_to_invalid_witness(tx)))
+            assert not result.done()
+            peer.send_and_ping(msg_tx(tx["tx"]))
+            assert_equal(result.result(timeout=10), tx["txid"])
+
+            self.log.info("Shutdown interrupts a wait")
+            result = submit(wallet.create_self_transfer())
+            node.stop()
+            assert_raises_rpc_error(-9, "Shutting down", result.result, timeout=10)
+            node.wait_until_stopped()
+
+
